annotations.title: Report a problem or idea to Divux

description: Stores a short report for Divux: a wrong dated figure, a tool that failed, a tool that is missing, or an idea. Fields are kind, a summary of up to 300 characters, an optional tool name, and optional details of up to 1,000 characters. The text is stored as sent, so the fields are for general descriptions without personal details. Divux keeps the text and does not reply. The limit is 5 reports a day per connection. Applies to questions about reporting a problem with Divux or suggesting an idea to Divux.

details.description: A short general description of the problem, without personal details.

kind.description: Type of report: a wrong dated figure, a broken tool, a missing tool or an idea.

summary.description: The problem or idea in one or two general sentences, without personal details.

tool.description: Name of the Divux tool involved, when one was involved.
